name: Type A
tagline: Splayed metal legs, with the services built into the bench.
about: Type A pairs splayed metal legs with services built into the bench: perforated metal screens and open shelves along the spine, flip-up boxes in the top and a raceway with a support beam underneath. A matching main table adds side storage for the cabin.
builtIn: Perforated metal screen panels (873 mm) with open shelves (300 mm), flip-up boxes in the top, and a raceway with a support beam. The main table has a 25 mm top and side storage with drawers and shutters
